name: EVOKE
description:
Evoke is the official fashion club of RV College of Engineering (RVCE), providing a dynamic platform for students to explore and express their creativity through fashion, modelling, styling, and visual arts.

The club brings together students with different talents and gives them opportunities to showcase their creativity, build confidence, and represent RVCE at various college events and competitions.

*Fashion Shows & Modelling – Organising and participating in fashion shows, ramp walks, and inter-college competitions.
* 🎨 Styling & Design – Creating concepts, themes, outfits, makeup, props, and overall visual aesthetics for performances.
* 📸 Content & Social Media – Creating promotional content, photoshoots, reels, posters, and managing the club’s digital presence.
* 🎭 Event Performances – Representing RVCE at fests, cultural events, club showcases, and competitions.
 *  🏆 Competitions – Participating in inter-collegiate fashion events and bringing recognition to RVCE.

Beyond modelling and fashion, Evoke encompasses a wide range of creative and organisational activities, including styling and costume design, makeup and grooming, choreography, photography, videography, content creation, social media, event planning, and production. Members work collaboratively to conceptualise themes, develop visual narratives, coordinate performances, and execute events from conception to completion.

events.name: Design Dash
events.detail: Unleash your inner designer in 15 minutes Turn thrifted chaos into a fashion queen! Race the clock with surprise themes, Create fierce looks and rule the scene AND CLAIM THE TITLE OF “STYLIST OF THE DAY

events.name: Lights, camera and fashion
events.detail: Think you’ve got the OOTD game on point? This is your moment to shine! In this fun & interactive contest, freshers will create their own “Outfit of the Day” reel using nothing but their creativity, confidence, and unique style. Whether it’s quirky, minimal, or bold – we want to see YOU bring your personality to life on screen. Submit your reel through the link/QR at the venue and get a chance to be featured on Evoke’s official Instagram page as the ultimate  “style icon of the day!’

events.name: Walk the talk Runway: 101
events.detail: Always wanted to try a runway walk? Here’s your chance!  Our models will show you how it’s done and help you practice your walk, poses, and confidence on stage.  Girls can bring heels if they want – it’s the perfect time to try them out! Come join us and let your modeling dreams come true with Team Evoke

events.name: Style in motion
events.detail: Get ready to bring the energy on stage! In this event, juniors will team up to create their own quick choreography and show off their style on the runway.  Your seniors will kick things off with a performance, and then it’s your turn to shine  Let your creativity flow and own the spotlight with Team Evoke.
